notes:
- **RexDesk updates itself.** It tells you when a new version is out and installs it in one click: download, signature check and relaunch take a few seconds.
- **A display made to your screen's measure** (RexDesk Host → Settings): the Mac's desktop takes this screen's exact size and refresh rate, up to 120 Hz.
- **Faster over the internet:** straight to the Mac's forwarded port, over TCP before the relay.
- A stream starts near the rate your network carried last time, instead of finding it again.
- RexDesk Host says when the Mac's display isn't sRGB and offers the sRGB profile, so colours look right.
- A paste right after a copy pastes what was just copied.
